en: The image shows a historical postcard with a color illustration on the left side, depicting an elaborate interior hall with grand chandeliers, marble columns, and people sitting and standing in period attire. The text below the image reads 'ROHITSCH-SAUERBRUNN. -- Kursaal.' The right side features handwritten text in German, a green postage stamp from the Austro-Hungarian Empire, and several postal markings.
